metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Clybor Consulting: gates that make Claude read the guide for a tool, think before it writes, and keep security hooks failing closed.

plugins.name: read-first
plugins.description: Blocks a tool call until Claude has loaded the guide skill you mapped to that tool. A guide skill is one part rules, one part operating manual. Missing one? The block message says which, and the bundled write-guide-skill skill drafts it in a standard format that a checker verifies.

plugins.name: think-first
plugins.description: Makes Claude run a sequential-thinking step before its first write in each turn, and again before retrying a tool call that just failed. Installs the Model Context Protocol sequential-thinking server it relies on, pinned to one version.

plugins.name: guard-resolve
plugins.description: Makes your security hooks fail closed. guard-resolve launches a guard and blocks the tool call if the guard's runtime or script is missing, instead of letting the call through silently. Includes a skill for choosing which hooks need it, a fail-closed guard template, and tests.
